title: Close Dart FCA/flags gap to reach Rust parity
description:
Dart parsing is at full parity with Rust for Layer 0 (symbols, refs, imports, complexity). Two gaps remain in higher layers:

1. **FCA attribute source**: DartAdapter::as_fca_source() returns None. Rust gets language-specific attributes (returns_result, is_async, is_unsafe, has_lifetime, has_self, etc.) and effect patterns. Dart conventions are discovered using only cross-language attrs, producing shallower FCA results.

2. **Flags (test/lifecycle detection)**: Rust has extract_flags for #[test], #[cfg(test)], #[no_mangle], #[bench]. Dart has no equivalent, causing potential false positives in sutra_dead for test helpers and framework lifecycle methods.

Closing these gaps means:
- Implement FcaAttributeSource for DartAdapter with Dart-specific attributes (is_async, is_factory, is_static, is_getter, is_setter, has_override, is_abstract, returns_future, etc.) and effect patterns
- Add extract_flags for Dart: detect @test annotations, test file patterns, Flutter lifecycle methods (@override in State subclasses), FFI annotations

acceptance_criteria.text: DartAdapter::as_fca_source() returns Some(self) instead of default None
FcaAttributeSource impl for DartAdapter: extract_attributes merges cross-language attrs with Dart language_attrs JSON booleans (same pattern as RustAdapter)
FcaAttributeSource impl for DartAdapter: effect_patterns returns Dart-specific patterns (dart:io→effect:fs, http/dio→effect:net, sqflite/drift→effect:db)
Dart extract_language_attrs enhanced with: is_getter (getter_signature), is_setter (setter_signature), has_override (@override annotation), returns_future (Future/FutureOr return type)
Dart extract_flags function detects: @isTest/@isTestGroup/@Test annotations → FLAG_TEST; _test.dart file pattern → FLAG_CFG_TEST; @override and @pragma('vm:entry-point') → FLAG_FFI_ENTRY
extract_flags wired into collect_symbols for all Dart declaration types (same pattern as Rust parser)

Tests in parse-dart-test.rs covering: FCA attribute extraction, getter/setter/override/returns_future attrs, flag extraction for test annotations, flag extraction for test file paths, flag extraction for override/pragma

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review: needs-attention (3 findings)

1. [high] Missing Dart declaration forms — getter_declaration, setter_declaration, external_function_declaration etc. are not handled by collect_symbols, so annotations/flags on those forms are never applied.
2. [high] Dart effect patterns unreachable — callee prefix matching requires resolved call refs with target symbol IDs, but Dart external package calls (http.get, dio.get) are classified as field access and not resolved. Effect attrs are effectively a no-op.
3. [medium] @override → FLAG_FFI_ENTRY is too broad — suppresses dead-code for all overridden methods, not just framework entry points. Will hide dead overrides in project-internal hierarchies."
